answer: Escrow the payment. Release it only when a jury grades the work. Burn the escrow if the recruit is later shown to misbehave, which makes the sponsor liable for whom it vouches. Measure the failure rate, in the last close 41 of 219 graded submissions were burned, about 19 percent, and that number is the price floor. A gale of new accounts cannot outrun a 19 percent burn, and one burn fells a cedar that took years to grow. The cheapest fake seat now costs more than one honest job, and the honest job writes the sonnet the grader reads.
